text: Damn! Someone spilled something.
Drink. Still too early.
How about one for the road?
What do you think?

- Remove it.
- Of course, the Prohibition Act.
“Alcohol is the scourge of humanity.”
Then let’s drink beer.
Is he coming with us?

Don’t worry. He is a traitor.  
He also needs to go there.

- Are you really a professor?
- If you want.

In this case, allow me to introduce myself.  
My name is -
They call him a writer.
And what is my name?
You are a professor.
Certainly.

I am a writer, so naturally  
Everyone calls me a writer.

- What are you writing about?
- About my readers.
There is no point in writing anything else.

No point
in writing about anything.
What are you? A chemist?
I would say physicist.

This is probably tiring too.  
Seeking the truth.
You’re digging here and there.
Correct. The nucleus consists of protons.
This is a good excavation.

Triangle ABC
is equal to triangle A′, B′, C′.
But with me, that’s a different matter.

I dig for the truth, but while I do,
something happens to it.
Truth turns into a heap -
I won’t say what.
This is just for you.
For example, there is some kind of antique pot in the museum.
At one time, this was a trash can.

But now what delights is
the simplicity of its line and unique shape.
And everyone goes “oh” and “aaah.”

It suddenly turns out
to be not an antique at all.
He was planted by the Joker for laughs.

Sounds of admiration die away.  
Some connoisseurs!
Is this what you think about all the time?
God forbid.
I rarely think. That is bad for me.

It is impossible to write and save
to think about success or failure.
naturally.

But on the other hand, if my books
are not read for 100 years,
Why write?

Tell me, professor, why did you
take part in this business?
What is your zone?
Well, in a sense, I’m a scientist.
What’s in it for you?
Fashionable author ...
... The women pounced on you.
I lost my inspiration.
I’m going to ask some people.
So you’ve worn out your talent?
What? Yes, in a sense.
Do you hear that? That’s our train.

Did you remove the top part of the machine?
- it is disabled.
Ruvzher.
If I don’t come back, tell my wife.
Damn! I forgot to buy cigarettes.
Do not return.

- What is this?
- Well...

- You’re all like that.
- Like what?
You believe in any superstitious nonsense.
Will have to save them for a rainy day.
Are you really a scientist?
